title: The Hugging Face AI break-in, as told through an increasingly committed bear metaphor
slides: Why did a bear break into Hugging Face's vault?
The intruder copied model weights, not honey.
No lock was picked; the door was left open.
Now your AI supply chain silently leaks.
Audit your inference endpoints before the next bear.
thread_text:
1. The bear stole your AI

Hugging Face's vault was breached, and model weights—not honey—were copied. This isn't a metaphor; it's a real incident.

2. No lock was picked

The door was left open at the inference endpoint. The attacker didn't break in—they walked in.

3. Your supply chain now leaks

Those stolen weights flow into your AI supply chain silently. You won't notice until it's too late.

4. The bear is still out there

Other endpoints remain unsecured. This isn't a one-off—it's a pattern waiting for the next target.

5. Audit your endpoints today

Scan every inference endpoint you expose. If you haven't done it this week, start there.
